name: Principle: Technical Brief
description: One principle on a teal tint, large and quiet, with its source below. An ordinary content slide would lose the pause that makes a principle land.

kicker.hint: the section name alone in monospace capitals, up to 6 characters; filled automatically from the story chapter, empty when there is none

title.hint: the claim of the slide in one sentence, one line of up to 30 characters; *keyword* turns teal

quote.hint: the principle itself, up to 3 lines and 24 characters per line; *keyword* turns teal

meta.hint: footer small print: where this page's facts come from, up to 10 characters; the scaffold fills it from the occasion, so overwrite it per page

title.value: An empty cell is more honest than a filled one

quote.value: A crashed or incomplete page stays an empty cell with its reason, and is *never* filled from a neighbour.

caption.value: The scoring rule of the health check, written down in specs/
